title: Paris-based Parallel, which develops AI agents for hospitals and is initially focused on medical coding workflows, raised a $20M Series A led by Index Ventures (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
summary: Tamara Djurickovic / Tech.eu: Paris-based Parallel, which develops AI agents for hospitals and is initially focused on medical coding workflows, raised a $20M Series A led by Index Ventures — Parallel develops AI agents to automate hospital administrative workflows, improving efficiency and reducing manual work across coding, billing, and operations.
